title: DataDeck
note: Subject v2.0. Each root script (battle.py, capacitor.py, tournament.py) must run without crashing; its output is compared to the subject example as a warning (other Creatures are allowed). The packages are imported: abstract Creature (attack abstract, describe from name + type), abstract CreatureFactory with two families, capabilities that are not Creatures, transform state kept in an attribute, packages exposing factories only, BattleStrategy with Normal / Aggressive / Defensive, is_valid() and act() per capability, a dedicated exception, the scenario of each script (strings computed from your own classes) and the battle function of tournament.py (each opponent fights every other once). Source: __init__.py in each exNN/, imports typing / abc / the ex packages only, no eval / exec, type hints, flake8 (root scripts and packages), mypy (follows the packages).
